AlCl3 is rejected because it is AX3 (trigonal planar) and forms dimers (Al2Cl6), not chains. MgCl2 and ZnCl2 are weaker matches since they are not typically described as electron-deficient in the same textbook sense and their solid-state structures are ionic lattices rather than covalent chain polymers.
